boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe places and activities with documented no-charge access on campus or nearby.

cards.title: Browse the Front Gallery
cards.subtitle: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Meet up to look through the rotating Front Gallery installation, then compare one work each before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery stop inside the Quick Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quick Center identifies the Front Gallery as one of its five galleries; gallery admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: SBU’s Quick Center unveils 30th performance & exhibition season
cards.access_notes: The Quick Center states that its galleries are open to the public year round at no charge; check its current gallery-hours notice before visiting.

cards.title: Take in the Kenney Gallery
cards.subtitle: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Use the Kenney Gallery as a low-key indoor meet-up and spend a few minutes discussing the current installation.
cards.short_summary: Free public gallery access at the Quick Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quick Center identifies the Kenney Gallery as one of its five galleries; gallery admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: SBU’s Quick Center unveils 30th performance & exhibition season
cards.access_notes: The Quick Center states that its galleries are open to the public year round at no charge; check its current gallery-hours notice before visiting.

cards.title: See the Dresser Foundation Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor, Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Plan a short gallery walk here and use the exhibition labels as prompts for a conversation with your group.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor gallery with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dresser Foundation Gallery is a Quick Center gallery, and the university states that gallery admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: SBU’s Quick Center hosts gallery talk Saturday
cards.access_notes: The university lists gallery hours as 10 a.m.–4 p.m. weekdays and noon–4 p.m. weekends on this page; confirm current hours before going.

cards.title: Walk the Paul W. Beltz Gallery
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Pair up for a quiet walk through the Beltz Gallery and use the artwork’s stories as an easy conversation starter.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor art-gallery hang with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Paul W. Beltz Gallery as a Quick Center gallery, and states that all five galleries have free public admission.
cards.source_title: Quick Center: ‘Art of Storytelling’ audio tour with Ed. Simone
cards.access_notes: The cited university page says all five galleries are free and open to the public; verify current hours and exhibitions before visiting.

cards.title: Explore the Marianne Letro Laine Gallery
cards.subtitle: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Drop in with friends to view the Laine Gallery’s installation, then pause in a common area to trade reactions.
cards.short_summary: Free public gallery access in the Quick Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Laine Gallery as one of the Quick Center’s five galleries; gallery admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: SBU’s Quick Center unveils 30th performance & exhibition season
cards.access_notes: The Quick Center states that its galleries are open to the public year round at no charge; check its current gallery-hours notice before visiting.

cards.title: Book a Quick Center gallery tour
cards.subtitle: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Coordinate a group visit through the gallery-tour request form and ask staff to tailor the tour to your group’s interests.
cards.short_summary: A no-charge guided art activity with advance coordination.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Bonaventure states that Quick Center gallery tours are available free of charge for any age group.
cards.source_title: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Submit the university’s gallery-tour request form in advance; the page says tours are available free of charge.

cards.entity_name: Olean Public Library free wireless access
cards.title: Settle in with free Wi-Fi at Olean Public Library
cards.subtitle: Olean Public Library, 134 N. 2nd Street, Olean
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or phone, agree to the library’s usage policy, and use the free wireless access for a shared study session.
cards.short_summary: A free internet-based study or catch-up stop in Olean.
cards.evidence_claim: Olean Public Library provides free wireless access for visitors using their own devices.
cards.access_notes: Wireless access requires agreement to the library’s usage policy; consult the library’s current hours before traveling from campus.

cards.entity_name: Allegany Public Library free high-speed internet
cards.title: Use free high-speed internet at Allegany Public Library
cards.subtitle: Allegany Public Library, 90 W. Main Street, Allegany
cards.notes: Meet at the library for a screen-based work session, then browse its public collections before you leave.
cards.short_summary: A nearby library activity with documented free internet access.
cards.evidence_claim: Allegany Public Library lists free high-speed internet access among the services it provides.
cards.source_title: About the Library – Allegany Public Library
cards.access_notes: The library lists free high-speed internet access; confirm current opening hours with the library before visiting.

cards.title: Walk Cattaraugus State Forest
cards.subtitle: Towns of New Albion and Mansfield, Cattaraugus County
cards.notes: Choose a daylight walk with a friend, stay on suitable routes, and follow DEC safety guidance for weather and wildlife.
cards.short_summary: A year-round outdoor destination with no fee.
cards.evidence_claim: NYSDEC lists Cattaraugus State Forest as open for recreation year-round with a fee of “Free.”
cards.access_notes: NYSDEC lists the forest as year-round and free; review its rules, directions, and outdoor-safety guidance before departure.

cards.title: Use the Olean Public Library computers
cards.subtitle: Olean Public Library, 134 N. 2nd Street, Olean
cards.notes: Bring identification if you need a guest pass, then use a public computer for research, applications, or a collaborative task.
cards.short_summary: Public computer access supported for cardholders and eligible guests.
cards.evidence_claim: Olean Public Library provides public-access computers for cardholders and guests, with guest passes available under its policy.
cards.access_notes: Eligible guests must show identification with name and current address for a computer guest pass; no purchase or admission is stated.
